title: Shares for "{name}"
hint: Owners and administrators see every project, even without a share, and so does whoever created it. For everyone else this list decides whether the project exists at all. The whole organization and any number of teams can be combined; the more generous share wins.
noTeams: There are no teams yet. Until then "the whole organization" is the only share — teams are created under "Members".
wirecloudTeams: The teams come from WireCloud. A team shows up here once one of its members has signed in to WireTerm.
newMember: A new member sees the connections right away, but the credentials only once a client with access has wrapped the project key for them. That happens at the next sync — unless they have not set up a master password yet.
rotateHint: Whoever loses a share also loses their copy of the project key — but what they have read until then, they still know. It only becomes tight with a new version: all credentials of the project are re-encrypted under it, and only those who are still shared with get it.
removingWarning: A share is being removed here. Renewing the key afterwards is the safe way.
rotated: Renewed: {secrets} credentials re-encrypted, wrapped for {n} person. | Renewed: {secrets} credentials re-encrypted, wrapped for {n} people.
rotatedWaiting: {n} without a master password get it as soon as they set one up.
rotatedSkipped: {n} could not be opened here and stay under the old version.
